The #31327 card thread read the tree at `origin/main` 604a2b3b9a. The claim's path for driver-sql was wrong, and the card's own Task items need four seams the surface did not list. The same applies to this card.

- File surface (replaces the claim's): `packages/drivers/driver-sql/**`; `packages/spec/src/data/driver/config-registry.zod.ts`, a new `packages/spec/src/data/driver/mssql.zod.ts` (the per-id config shape `DRIVER_CONFIG_SCHEMAS` requires) and its `driver/index.ts` export; `packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts` (the managed-mode refusal at `defineStack`); `packages/spec/src/data/type-compat.ts`; their tests and generated artefacts; ADR-0015 §4.6; `packages/services/service-datasource/src/default-datasource-driver-factory.ts` (and `connect-failure-remedy.ts` if needed), so the id is served by driver-sql; the introspection seam the Studio Tables tab and `list_remote_tables` / `import_object` read; `ui/` connection-form types only if Type Check UI reds on the widened `BuiltinDriverId`; `content/docs/data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx` (a SQL Server section); `.changeset/**`. Stop on any other breach.
- Live cell env: `OS_TEST_MSSQL_URL` (the `OS_` prefix rule, matching `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL`), not the card's bare name.
- Serial constraints: `datasource.zod.ts`, `driver/index.ts` and `default-datasource-driver-factory.ts` join the shared spots with #31327 / #31328. Whichever PR lands second merges main and reconciles.

Clause-② stays `yes` (provisional).
